title: Design System: Illustrious Technical Field Guides

narrative.overview: Security and operational setup become a legible sequence. Wayfinding graphics carry real information while code acts as evidence.
keyCharacteristics: Structural color encodes sequence or state.
Condensed labels pair with hyperlegible reading text.
Flat ruled surfaces replace decorative card grids.

rules.name: Structural Color
rules.body: Route colors encode sequence, transfer, or warning; they do not decorate generic containers.

rules.name: Flat by Default
rules.body: Use fields, borders, and route geometry instead of ambient shadows.

dos: Show the complete operational sequence before the reader scrolls.
Pair claims with exact commands, source links, or observable boundaries.
donts: Do not turn instructions into a same-size card grid.
Do not use terminal styling as shorthand for technical credibility.
